blueprint.name: IBM ROKS + BNK (roksbnkctl)
blueprint.description: Provision an IBM Cloud ROKS cluster and install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes (BNK) with roksbnkctl. Credential-backed by an IBM Cloud credential template; region and resource group inherit from the selected template.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for all resource names (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: cluster_name
required.label: Cluster name (or existing name/ID)
required.description: Name for a new ROKS cluster, or the name/ID of an existing cluster to attach to.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region for the cluster. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: cluster_create
optional.label: Create a new cluster
optional.description: On = provision a new ROKS cluster. Off = attach to the existing cluster named above (set 'Use existing cluster').

optional.name: use_existing_cluster
optional.label: Use existing cluster
optional.description: Attach to the existing cluster named above (register). Mutually exclusive with 'Create a new cluster'.
